[/color][center][color=#ea9999]Camping tent with tarp.
[/color]
[color=#00ffff]Just that.[/color][/center]
[/size]The appearance also changes with the seasons.
Animated animals are also available.

Note: When entering, do the same as for the door. It is a specification that you can't get in just by touching it. (Because there is no tunnel door in the CP building.)

Currently available in English and Japanese and Spanish.

Downloads.Description:
Added "Entrance Sleep" to ModConfig settings (default is false).
If you turn this setting on, you will be able to sleep when you touch the tile at the entrance of the tent (before entering the indoor map).
